title: AHB Protocol Violation: Illegal HTRANS Transition
description: A master attempts to change HTRANS while the slave is asserting a wait state. This is a critical protocol violation and a common source of RTL bugs.

annotations.message: Master issues a NONSEQ address phase.
Slave drives HREADY low, meaning the data phase for 0xA0 is stalled. The master correctly issues the *next* address phase (0xA4, SEQ) and must hold it.
VIOLATION! The master changes HTRANS from SEQ to IDLE while HREADY is still low! The master is not allowed to change the address phase signals until HREADY is high.
